meta_description:
343 likes, 243 comments - phoenixpalladium on January 11, 2023: "What's cooking?👩🏻🍳🍴👨🏻🍳
Guess the name of the dish from its ingredients and stand a chance to win @foodhallindia hampers worth Rs 3,000.🤩

Follow these simple steps:
1) Answer the question in the comments below
2) Tag 3 friends and ask them to participate
3) Follow Phoenix Palladium on Instagram.

Contest Terms & Conditions:
- Results will be announced on 20th January
- 3 winners will be shortlisted. Each winner will get ONE Foodhall hamper.
- Winners will collect hampers from Helpdesk, Palladium, Mumbai by showing a valid ID.
- Any disagreement with any of the above-stated rules will result in immediate disqualification.
- The decision of Phoenix Palladium, Mumbai will be final and abiding.

#PhoenixPalladium #Foodhall #Contest #ContestAlert #ContestMumbai #GuessTheDish #Comment #Mumbai".
